text.zh_CN: 答辩大厅很安静。大屏幕上正回放着你从第一天入职远望、第一次下单、第一笔股息、经历利率冲击、做空与杠杆，直至黑色星期五压力测试的全部交割单与净值曲线。
text.en: The grand defense amphitheater stands quiet. The projector scrolls through your entire trade journal from day one: first order, first dividend, rate shocks, shorting, margin calls, through the Black Friday stress test.

text.zh_CN: 七年来，学院里一直有传言，说我当年看错宏观周期，才导致旧基金清盘。今天我可以把真相说出来：那一年我没有看错趋势。市场只需要再多三天，就会证明我的判断是对的。
text.en: For seven years, the academy has whispered that I misread the macro cycle and caused the old fund's liquidation. Today I can tell you the truth: I did not misread the trend. The market needed only three more days to prove my call right.

text.zh_CN: 但我把每一分钱都加上了三倍杠杆。我的保证金撑不到那三天。与其等着被强制平仓，我选择主动清盘，把每一分能找回的现金还给数百个普通家庭。那年我不是输给市场，也不是输给判断——我输给了杠杆，和那个以为只要看对方向就能扛住一切的自己。
text.en: But I had put every dollar on three times leverage. My margin could not last those three days. Rather than wait for a forced liquidation, I chose to wind down the fund myself and return every dollar I could recover to hundreds of ordinary families. I did not lose to the market that year, and I did not lose to my call — I lost to leverage, and to the self that believed being right meant being able to endure anything.

text.zh_CN: 台下的顾言神情疲惫，锋芒收敛了许多。他默默看着你，微微点头。他在这场压力测试里摔了一跤，也第一次学会了敬畏。
text.en: Gu Yan sits in the audience, worn down, his edge tempered. He watches you and gives a small nod. The stress test cost him dearly, and taught him awe for the first time.

text.zh_CN: 你已经完成了全部 32 个单元的学业考验，也经历了一轮完整的市场周期。你向学院证明：活下来，比赚得快更重要。远望学院全体导师准予你最高荣誉毕业。告诉我，你的掌舵之路通向何方？
text.en: You have completed all 32 units and lived through a complete market cycle. You proved Farview's core creed: surviving long outranks sprinting fast. The board awards you graduation with highest honors. Where do you steer next?

text.zh_CN: 确立未来的职业掌舵方向：
【稳健掌舵人】继续执掌远望一期，以受托人底线为信仰，做常青基金经理。
text.en: [Steadfast Helmsman] Continue piloting Farview Fund; make fiduciary integrity your religion as an enduring portfolio manager.

toast.zh_CN: 毕业去向：成为远望一期正式掌舵人
toast.en: Career destiny: Lead Portfolio Manager of Farview Fund

text.zh_CN: 【学院导师】留在远望交易学院任教，把对市场的敬畏与风险纪律传承给后人。
text.en: [Academy Mentor] Join the academy faculty; pass down market humility and rigorous risk discipline to future apprentices.

toast.zh_CN: 毕业去向：接任远望交易学院导师

text.zh_CN: 【独行游侠】创办激进对冲团队，在更广阔的高风险深海探索极致策略边界。
text.en: [Independent Maverick] Launch an agile hedge fund; pioneer high-conviction frontiers across deep waters.

toast.zh_CN: 毕业去向：扬帆深海，成立独立对冲基金
toast.en: Career destiny: Independent Hedge Fund Founder

text.zh_CN: 王先生在台下带头起立鼓掌。我走上前，把一枚刻着远望罗盘的掌舵人印章交到你手中：“从今天起，远望一期的这艘大船，交给你了。”
text.en: Mr. Wang rises to lead the applause. I step forward and place the brass Farview compass seal in your hands: 'From this day onward, Farview's flagship belongs to you.'

text.zh_CN: 台下没有掌声。王先生坐在后排，远远看了你一眼。我走上前，把印章交到你手中：“船交给你了。但记住，印章不等于信任。”
text.en: There is no applause. Mr. Wang watches from the back row, then looks away. I step forward and place the seal in your hands: 'The ship is yours. But remember: a seal is not trust.'

text.zh_CN: 我抚掌微笑：“教人避开深渊，往往比自己跨越深渊更难。远望的讲台，从此多了一位真正懂得市场的引路人。”
text.en: I clap and smile: 'Teaching others to avoid the abyss is often harder than crossing it yourself. Farview's podium now has a guide who truly understands the market.'

text.zh_CN: 我在台下站起身，眼神里重新燃起锐利的光：“我等你。在深水区里，也许你真能走出一条既有进攻性、又能活着回来的新路。”
text.en: I rise from my seat, a sharp light returning to my eyes: 'I'll be waiting. In the deep water, maybe you can carve a path that is both aggressive and survivable.'

text.zh_CN: 答辩委员会一致通过。祝贺你，交易员，愿你在任何狂风巨浪面前，心中永远有一张清醒的航海图。
text.en: The committee affirms with unanimous consent. Congratulations, trader. Through every hurricane yet to come, may your internal chart remain clean and unwavering.
